paragraphs: Rabbi Yudan ben Tarfon: Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit, chapter 1, halakhah 10.
Rabbi Levi son of Rabbi Tarfon: Eichah Rabbah 1:33. Shimon ben Tarfon: Shevuot 47b.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s Sheviit 1:10 locator and Yudan ben Tarfon are retained. The Guggenheimer digital chapter has six halakhot; 1:6:3 instead reads Rabbi Yudan, ke-Rabbi Trifan. The consulted Eichah Rabbah 1:33 has Rabbi Levi be-Rabbi Tarfon, while Shevuot 47b names Shimon ben Tarfon.
